integrity: Proof includes explicit local-state bijection, finite symbolic determinant, and algebraic Taylor extraction; supplied verifier independently checks direct graph instances and finite determinant. No external or independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Proved only for labelled cyclic prisms of length at least three and the 1-limited domination condition; all-cardinality closed walks for lengths one or two are formal only. Does not classify wider products, unlabelled orbits, or other domination variants. Historical-priority and independent-review risks persist.
title: Complete 1-limited domination spectrum and an infinite gap family of circular prisms
